- When sentiment is consistently high (≥0.77) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 2–5% for next 3–5 days.
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 75), model often overshoots and fails to correct; cap forecast at +3–5% above peak for next 5 days.
- If sentiment is low (≤0.27) and price is falling, model underestimates drop; add 1–3% buffer below true low for next 3–7 days.
- Model overreacts to short-term sentiment swings; smooth 3-day moving average of sentiment before adjusting forecast.
- If true outcome is below 65 and forecast is above 70, model is overconfident; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 7 days.
- When sentiment is mixed (0.27–0.53) and price is trending, model often misjudges direction; align forecast with 2-period moving average of history.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overestimate mean reversion; cap forecast at 10% below 30-day moving average of true prices.
